title: 4521-ESP-AGE-67-70-0022 R1
summary:
- The document is an instrument specification for well water pumps.
- Revisions are tracked with revision numbers, dates, and descriptions.
- Confidentiality terms restrict use and reproduction of information.
- Scope includes supply of instruments, cables, gaskets, manifolds, etc.
- Supplier must deliver material to designated locations and track purchases.
- All materials must meet NEC, IEEE, UL standards.
- Vendor data is crucial for project progress.
- Equipment must be delivered to the purchaser's manufacturing site.
- Monthly shipping of 2 units starting January 2012.
- Spare parts list and pricing required with quotation.
- Equipment subject to inspection by Abener Teyma personnel.
- Alternate quotations invited for improvements in price, delivery or performance.
